title: Love to Hurt You
shortDescription: She likes to hurt. He likes to kill. Decadent, dark and gripping, Love to Hurt You is bestselling author Rahul Saini's most surprising novel yet.
description: She likes to hurt. He likes to kill. They say everyone wants love and happiness, but what if that is not true?
"Everyone is entitled to one true love in life. My true love is money and fame." — Garun
"We had made a promise. You said we would be together forever. And you left me alone here." — Maya

Decadent, dark and gripping, Love to Hurt You is bestselling author Rahul Saini's most surprising novel yet. A story that forces you to think what impact all the dark content in entertainment can have on you!

title: The Orange Hangover
shortDescription: A young architect's lavish life goes haywire in his hometown when he gets tied to a crime. A story about personal values and second chances.
description: Rishabh is a young architect who is leading a very lucky and lavish life. He has a great job, a fabulous lifestyle, the coolest friends and a lovely girlfriend. However, all of this goes for a toss and he has to pack his bags and go back to his small hometown.

His friends are nowhere close and his relationship with his girlfriend has not been going so well. To add to his hardships, he gets involved in a terrible crime. The whole town thinks he is nuts, but there is one girl who understands him. Will she be able to help him?

The Orange Hangover is a grippy, engaging story of a young architect whose life has been going haywire, teaching us how to learn from our experiences and stand up for personal values when it matters most.

title: Paperback Dreams
shortDescription: How low will you stoop to fulfil your dreams? A witty, shocking story of young writers and the murky secrets of Indian publishing.
description: How low will you stoop to fulfil your dreams? Jeet Roy, a college Casanova, has published a book by unfair means. All he wants is to earn loads of money and have hot girls chase after him wherever he goes!

Rohit Sehdev, a one-book-old popular fiction writer, is furious when he finds out that his publisher has cheated him out of his royalties. Karun Ahuja is a highly ambitious schoolboy who wants to win the heart of his lady love by writing a novel.

Ruthlessly exploiting these ambitious young men is their unscrupulous publisher. Sometimes funny, sometimes shocking, Paperback Dreams is the story of a new breed of young writers who will do anything to get famous, fast.

title: Just For You
shortDescription: When you love someone, what's there to prove? Everything! An adorable, bittersweet story about love and its responsibilities.
description: When you love someone, what's there to prove? Everything! It looks like life is teaching Rohit a lesson. His publishing deals, his relationships, even his job – nothing seems to be working out.

To make matters worse, Karan is still trying his best to ruin him as a writer. But when Nisha leaves him, it's the ultimate blow. To win her back, Rohit must prove he loves her enough to do things that matter to her.
As Rohit takes control of his life, he begins to find things slowly changing for the better. Just for You is an adorable, bittersweet story about love, publishing, and real responsibility.

title: Those Small Lil Things
shortDescription: Rahul Saini's national acclaim debut novel about college life, growing up, friendship, and the small moments that matter.
description: Rahul Saini's debut novel "Those Small Lil Things" achieved national acclaim upon its release in 2008.
A lighthearted yet perceptive tale of youth, college friendship, ambitious dreams, and the small everyday moments that shape our lives forever.

title: Just Like In The Movies
shortDescription: A comical rollercoaster of youth, romance, and film-style drama.
description: A fun, fast-paced novel exploring young romance, cinematic dreams, and the humorous twists of fate.
